principle: Romance is directional, causal and consent-based. Canon compatibility permits a possibility; it never creates attraction, consent, a date or a relationship.
eligibility: one authored sex_category is male and the other female
both character identities and population slots already exist
no represented hard romantic boundary forbids the interaction
player_agency: player romantic interest is never inferred
invalid or unanswered romantic opportunities do not auto-select a player response
npc_initiation: NPC may initiate toward player only from authoritative NPC-to-player romantic_interest_state
species, appearance tags, player proximity and narrative convenience cannot create NPC interest
rules: Mutual attraction does not itself establish dating.
Invitation is not consent to a relationship or intimacy.
Acceptance may be withdrawn before the date.
A romantic rejection does not automatically create hostility, resentment or rivalry.
A date requires mutually compatible time, real travel feasibility and an actual compatible venue.
A scheduled date does not prove attendance or completion.
Relationship-state change requires represented completed-date or explicit reciprocal commitment evidence.
Friendship, favors, rank, gifts, persistence, prior dating and existing relationship do not imply consent.
Consent is context-specific and may be refused or withdrawn.
Step 10 produces no autonomous NPC-to-NPC romantic evolution; Step 11 owns that use case.
Step 10 does not force wellbeing, academic, disciplinary or career consequences.
